status: Playable conceptual demo implemented with supplied Fi artwork and plain test geometry

boss.appearance: Supplied green enemy artwork at twice regular enemy visual size
boss.audio: Synthesized falling whistle/whoosh during warning, impact at landing

swipe.trigger: Fi within two cells on same row or column
swipe.direction: Toward Fi, footprint fixed when warning begins

boss.shadow: Traced rock silhouette, flattened onto floor; grows to proportional rock width

notes: Enemy artwork is a regular enemy, not the boss.
No faith mechanics or additional story content have been invented.
Enemies stop initiating pursuit steps outside the approved 4-tile straight-line radius; contact cadence remains 0.4 seconds.
temporaryMotionPanel: Includes Fi and enemy artwork offsets, motion, attack timing, sensing, meteor interval range

hurtAudio.Fi: Short synthetic young fox yelp; no spoken words
hurtAudio.boss: Louder, deeper, 1.4-second synthesized burp; dedicated non-overlapping voice

meteorRun.targets: Random fully visible footprints around Fi
meteorRun.timingPanel: Minimum and maximum intervals, constrained to 2–10 seconds
meteorRun.activation: Fi approaches the second group at column 12; first warning starts immediately, later waits randomized 2–10 seconds

swordHurtbox: Follows Fi continuously during swing, each target damaged once per swing
